architecture_name: Dual-Backbone 2D Alignment U-Net (ConvNeXt-Tiny + ResNet34d) + Spatial Plane-KNN + Kinematic PF/HMM + Level-2 Meta-Ensemble
architecture_summary: Fuses a 12-channel 2D sequence-to-reference similarity tensor (ConvNeXt-Tiny + ResNet34d + BiGRU + 3-view TTA), NaN-masked Coupled-Invariant Kinematic PF + 2D Rotating-Dip HMM, distance-gated Spatial Plane-KNN, and anchor-residual CatBoost/XGBoost/LightGBM/Ridge/TabM Level-2 stack.

assumptions.why_it_matters: The 12-channel 2D alignment image encodes similarity between observed sequence logs and a paired 1D reference curve at every candidate vertical offset.
assumptions.if_violated_action: DIVERGE_DO_NOT_COPY 2D reference-alignment CNN; instead explore 1D Temporal ConvNet (TCN) / BiGRU sequence encoders or autoregressive residual GBDTs directly on sequence dynamics.

assumptions.why_it_matters: Channels 0-3 assume one primary scalar sensor log (e.g., GR) compared to a 1D reference log.
assumptions.if_violated_action: ADAPT 2D input stem: if sensor_channel_count > 1 (e.g., multi-sensor telemetry/IMU/multi-log), stack per-channel similarity/bandpass maps or replace manual similarity with a learned 1D-to-2D cross-attention/outer-product similarity encoder.

assumptions.why_it_matters: Linear interpolation across long sensor NaN gaps hallucinates false peaks (`sp4.5` degraded from 9.70 -> 11.23 RMSE); NaN-masked likelihood + explicit validity mask channel are essential when missing rate > 5%.
assumptions.if_violated_action: ADAPT sensor likelihood & masking: if missing rate > 65%, down-weight sensor similarity and rely primarily on coupled kinematics/spatial geometry; if missing rate == 0%, simplify mask channel and test sharper sensor noise sigma.

assumptions.why_it_matters: On ROGII 99.6% of rows satisfy |TVT - last_TVT| <= 72 ft (while |U - last_U| exceeded 72 ft on 52.5% of rows), so indexing the 2D CNN vertically in (y - last_y) prevented clipping.
assumptions.if_violated_action: ADAPT vertical grid & coordinate frame: empirically compare p99(|y - last_y|) vs p99(|U - last_U|) on training folds before training the 2D CNN; choose the tighter frame and set half_span >= 1.2 * p99.

assumptions.why_it_matters: Spatial Plane-KNN & Dense IDW exploit neighbor entities' auxiliary surfaces gated by distance + prefix RMSE (high error standalone 23.8-37.8, helpful only when distance-gated).
assumptions.if_violated_action: ADAPT by omitting channel 7 (spatial surface stripe) and spatial consensus terms cleanly when spatial coordinates or train-only surfaces do not exist.

assumptions.why_it_matters: Disjoint GroupKFold entities require entity-grouped inner Optuna/early-stopping splits, excluding entity_id from categorical features, order-preserving sampling, and jump-safe SavGol.
assumptions.if_violated_action: ADAPT CV & encoding: if entities overlap across train/test, switch to Stratified/Time split and evaluate entity OOF target encoding.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Copy 6.39-LB public kernel sp4.5 multi-seed PF with linear GR gap interpolation + heel calibration.
divergent_options.rationale: Linearly interpolating across 40-60% NaN GR gaps hallucinated false formation signatures (11.23 raw / 10.96 heel-cal vs 9.70 NaN-masked PF+HMM -> REJECTED).

divergent_options.hypothesis: NaN-masked coupled-invariant Kinematic PF + exact 2D Rotating-Dip Forward-Backward HMM + IRLS U-projection.
divergent_options.rationale: Strong zero-ML physics prior (-6.16 RMSE over baseline, -1.54 better than sp4.5), retained as Channels 5-6 and inverse-variance prior rather than final standalone model.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Predict TVT directly from neighbor wells via local Plane-KNN & Dense IDW surfaces.
divergent_options.rationale: High standalone RMSE (23.8 dense / 37.9 plane) on isolated wells, but strong on dense-field wells (dist < 0.03); adapted into distance-gated inverse-variance consensus instead of standalone predictor.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Index 2D alignment tensor vertically in coupled invariant U=TVT+Z vs TVT-centered (TVT - last_TVT).
divergent_options.rationale: Empirical span check proved |U - last_U| > 72 ft on 52.5% of rows whereas |TVT - last_TVT| <= 72 ft on 99.6% of rows; TVT-centered Dual-Backbone ConvNeXt-Tiny (8.96) + ResNet34d (9.06) ensemble converged to 8.4791 raw / 8.4070 U-projected.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Apply standard Savitzky-Golay postprocessing + entity_id categorical target encoding on Level-2 GBDTs.
divergent_options.rationale: Shuffled >30k subsampling + unseen GroupKFold entity codes caused SavGol cross-well boundary bleed (+2.26 RMSE) and inner-val entity leakage; fixed order-preserving sampling, jump-safe SavGol, group-aware inner splits, and entity_id exclusion.

divergent_options.hypothesis: Anchor-residual CatBoost + Optuna XGBoost + Optuna LightGBM + Ridge + TabM over inverse-variance consensus (8.2647).
divergent_options.rationale: CatBoost branch hit 8.1941 OOF and combined multi-stream ensemble converged to 8.25072 with 0.0 zero-pickle standalone parity.

convergence_rationale: Converged on Dual-Backbone 2D Alignment U-Net + NaN-masked PF/HMM + distance-gated Spatial Consensus + Group-safe Level-2 Anchor-Residual Meta-Ensemble (15.8567 -> 8.25072 RMSE) only after falsifying linear-interp PF, U-space windowing, standalone spatial KNN, and blind SavGol/entity-TE.
copy_vs_adapt_rules: DO NOT blindly copy the 2D reference-alignment CNN if the new problem lacks a 1D reference curve — diverge to 1D TCN/BiGRU/Transformer or multi-scale GBDTs.
ALWAYS inspect sensor channel count, calibration drift, and NaN gap distribution before building 2D similarity channels; adapt multi-channel sensors rather than forcing single-channel formulas.
ALWAYS measure p99 target excursion in both raw target space and coupled-invariant space before fixing a 2D vertical window span.
NEVER copy postprocessing smoothers or target encodings without verifying GroupKFold entity disjointness and sequential row ordering.
